headline: Man sentenced to death for attempted rape and murder of 12-year-old
summary: A Magura court has handed down the death penalty to Hasan Sheikh for the 2022 killing of a young girl in Sreepur upazila.
details: A Magura court has sentenced 28-year-old Hasan Sheikh to death for the attempted rape and murder of a 12-year-old girl in Sreepur upazila in 2022.
The verdict was delivered by Magura District and Sessions Judge Md Mizanur Rahman in a packed courtroom this afternoon.
The incident occurred on March 17, 2022, when the victim went to a field to harvest garlic. Hasan Sheikh dragged her to a bamboo grove and attempted to rape her.
When the girl resisted, the convict strangled her with her own scarf and mutilated her body with a razor blade.
The victim's body was recovered by police two days after she went missing.
The court's decision was based on DNA evidence from hair and other samples collected at the crime scene, which matched Hasan Sheikh.
A total of 11 witnesses testified during the trial, leading to the court finding the accused guilty.
The victim's mother expressed satisfaction with the verdict and called for the immediate execution of the sentence.
caption:
A man has been sentenced to death for the brutal murder and attempted rape of a 12-year-old girl in Magura.

A Magura court has sentenced 28-year-old Hasan Sheikh to death for the attempted rape and murder of a 12-year-old girl in Sreepur upazila in 2022.

The verdict was delivered by Magura District and Sessions Judge Md Mizanur Rahman in a packed courtroom this afternoon.

The incident occurred on March 17, 2022, when the victim went to a field to harvest garlic. Hasan Sheikh dragged her to a bamboo grove and attempted to rape her.

When the girl resisted, the convict strangled her with her own scarf and mutilated her body with a razor blade.

The victim's body was recovered by police two days after she went missing.

The court's decision was based on DNA evidence from hair and other samples collected at the crime scene, which matched Hasan Sheikh.

A total of 11 witnesses testified during the trial, leading to the court finding the accused guilty.

The victim's mother expressed satisfaction with the verdict and called for the immediate execution of the sentence.

headline_marked: 1 lakh people [[stranded in Hatia]] by heavy rain and tidal surges
headline: 1 lakh people stranded in Hatia by heavy rain and tidal surges
summary: Severe waterlogging across 11 unions and the municipality has caused Tk 30.35 crore in damages, destroying crops across 25,000 hectares of land.
details: Continuous heavy rainfall and tidal surges have flooded vast areas of Hatia, an island upazila in Noakhali, leaving over 1 lakh residents stranded across 11 unions and the municipality.
A 24 km embankment has been damaged, with residential areas flooded as tidal waters breached embankments near Banglabazar and Afajia Bazar.
The disaster has devastated agriculture, submerging crops and seedbeds across nearly 25,000 hectares of land, including Aush rice, Aman seedbeds, and seasonal vegetables.
Financial losses are estimated at Tk 30.35 crore, affecting approximately 38,564 farmers who have seen their crops rot due to persistent waterlogging.
Local residents report that roads in some unions are submerged under three to four feet of water, while Nijhum Dwip union remains entirely inundated due to a lack of an embankment.
While cautionary signals for river and sea ports were lifted yesterday, intermittent rains are expected to persist for two to three days before conditions normalize.
The local Department of Agricultural Extension has stated that aid will be distributed to listed farmers once the necessary allocation is received.
caption:

Local residents report that roads in some unions are submerged under three to four feet of water, while Nijhum Dwip union remains entirely inundated due to a lack of an embankment.
